    feat(dashboard): neutral corporate design with light and dark themes

    system fonts and no external requests, neutral labels (Tokens saved,
    Recent runs, Runs not optimized, Excluded sources, Re-enable), status

    per browser, applied before first paint to avoid a flash.

commit 9269b1ab9b128ad1c2333ddd062a0636eee630e7
Author: Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>
Date:   Sat Oct 10 13:17:45 2026 +0200

    fix(cli): installed hooks tag runs with their agent and session
    
    Only wrap sets GASCOIGNE_AGENT and GASCOIGNE_SESSION for an agent's
    shell. With hooks registered for good (wrap -print, the only way for
    Cursor), commands rewritten to gascoigne exec ran without them, so their
    runs had no agent in gain and the dashboard. The hook now adds -agent and
    -session (the hook event's session id) to the rewritten command when the
    environment lacks them; wrapped commands stay as short as before.
    
    The dashboard labels runs without an agent as "no agent", with a
    tooltip: a terminal or script, or recorded before runs were tagged.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit 52e2a2377855b00d7bd21da7d69e64ad961b30f1
Author: Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>
Date:   Sat Oct 10 13:00:46 2026 +0200

    feat(config): user config laid over defaults, written on first run
    
    A user config file used to replace the built-in one, so it had to repeat
    every pipeline and component. It is now laid over the defaults: maps
    merge, values and lists replace, empty keys keep the default. On first
    run, with no -config or GASCOIGNE_CONFIG, gascoigne writes
    ~/.config/gascoigne/config.yaml from configs/user.yaml: every setting of
    every component, commented out with a short note, so the defaults apply
    until something is uncommented. Existing files are never overwritten.
    
    Tests keep the template honest: uncommented it equals the defaults, and
    every Config field of every used component must appear in it.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit 66ccabce3ef359b10f0877c1b93b77c72968008b
Author: Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>
Date:   Sat Oct 10 12:16:46 2026 +0200

    feat(cli): background server keeps the dashboard up; reset stats
    
    One server per user on 127.0.0.1:7878 (the port is the lock) hosts the
    dashboard. exec, the codex hook, mcp, mcp-proxy and wrap start it detached
    when /api/health does not answer, so the dashboard is there whenever
    gascoigne runs; wrap prints its address. A server from another build is
    replaced, one serving another ledger left alone. Optimization still runs
    in each process: startup is ~7 ms and the check ~0.3 ms, so a missing
    server never slows or fails an agent. GASCOIGNE_SERVER=off opts out.
    
    gascoigne server run|start|stop|status manage it; dashboard prints the
    address. gascoigne reset deletes recorded runs by session, agent, model
    or period (flags only, never env); -all also drops originals and failure
    history. The dashboard gets Reset stats and Stop server buttons.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
